subject: Intermittent model errors — restart coordination & customer follow-up
messages:
From: Anna Keller <anna.keller@starlightai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intermittent 500s on generation endpoint

Marcus —

We're seeing a spike in 500 responses from the /v1/generate endpoint starting ~08:58 PDT. Errors look correlated with requests that include long context (>4k tokens) and appear for 30-90s windows. This is impacting our checkout recommendation flow — conversion dropped ~12% in the last 20 minutes. Can you confirm you're seeing the same and provide an ETA for mitigation? We flagged support@starlightai but wanted to escalate to your team directly.

I've attached a small sample of error payloads (starlight_error_log_0618.zip).

Thanks,
Anna Keller
Head of Integrations, Starlight AI
anna.keller@starlightai.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Keller <anna.keller@starlightai.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intermittent 500s on generation endpoint

Anna — thanks for flagging and for the sample. We've seen the anomaly on our telemetry as well (elevated 5xx starting ~08:56 PDT). I'm standing up a focused incident channel with SRE and runtime engineering. Immediate plan:
- Short-term mitigation: perform targeted rolling restarts of the serving group handling long-context variants to flush kernel state (15-25 min).
- Canary: route 10% of traffic to an unaffected pool after restart and verify error rates.
- Customer comms: I will send a brief executive-facing update in ~30–45m with timeline and next steps.

I'll keep you updated in this thread and will call out any impact to SLAs.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Intermittent 500s on generation endpoint

On Fri, Jun 18, 2027 at 9:18 AM Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Anna — thanks for flagging and for the sample. We've seen the anomaly on our telemetry as well (elevated 5xx starting ~08:56 PDT). I'm standing up a focused incident channel with SRE and runtime engineering. Immediate plan:
> - Short-term mitigation: perform targeted rolling restarts of the serving group handling long-context variants to flush kernel state (15-25 min).
> - Canary: route 10% of traffic to an unaffected pool after restart and verify error rates.
> - Customer comms: I will send a brief executive-facing update in ~30–45m with timeline and next steps.

Update: we completed the first targeted restart on the long-context pool at 09:46 PDT; error rate dropped to baseline for that pool within 3 minutes. We performed a second restart at 09:58 PDT for remaining hosts. Canary traffic (10%) currently at nominal error rates.

Next steps from ops:
- Continue validation for 1 hour while gradually increasing canary to 30%.
- Enable additional request-level harness to capture stack traces for any remaining 5xx.
- Postmortem artifacts: drafting immediate cause hypothesis and will attach a postmortem draft and runbook patch for your review.

I've attached postmortem-draft-0618.md and runbook-diff-0618.patch to this thread for transparency.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Keller <anna.keller@starlightai.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 13:04:00 -0700
Subject: Service update and executive summary — Starlight AI (short-term mitigation completed)

Anna / Tom —

TL;DR: We identified a regression in the long-context allocation path that caused transient kernel contention under certain request size distributions. We performed targeted restarts and a controlled canary; service is restored to normal for all routes. Brief timeline and actions below plus next steps and proposed remediation credits.

Timeline (PDT):
- 08:56 — first elevated 5xx observed in Redwood telemetry.
- 09:12 — customer report received (this thread).
- 09:18 — incident declared; SRE + runtime engineering engaged.
- 09:46 — first targeted restart of long-context pool (partial restoration).
- 09:58 — second restart & canary initiated (error rates at baseline).
- 10:30 — canary expanded to 30%; continued monitoring.
- 12:40 — all traffic restored to steady-state; no further 5xx spikes detected.

Impact:
- Affected endpoints: /v1/generate when requests included context >4k tokens, ~12 minutes of elevated error rate for affected hosts.
- Customer impact: Starlight reported a ~12% hit to a checkout flow conversion window during the spike.

Immediate remediation performed:
- Targeted rolling restarts of long-context serving hosts to clear kernel-level contention.
- Canary routing and phased traffic ramp to validate stability.
- Temporary request-size guardrails enabled for affected model variants to prevent recurrence while a permanent fix is developed.

Proposed next steps / commitments:
1) Postmortem delivery: we'll deliver a final postmortem with root cause, timeline, and corrective actions within 72 hours (draft attached).
2) Runbook & runtime fix: SRE and runtime eng will ship a kernel allocation fix and update the runbook; expected release in 10 business days.
3) Monitoring: add request-size and kernel-contention SLOs + alerts within 7 business days.
4) Remediation credit: Redwood is prepared to offer a one-time service credit equivalent to 10% of June usage for the affected routes for Starlight AI; we can route the credit through your account team.

Attachments: postmortem-draft-0618.md, runbook-diff-0618.patch, starlight_error_log_0618.zip

If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-minute post-incident review with your engineering and product teams tomorrow to walk through the postmortem draft. Please let me know a window that works.

—Marcus Lin
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
From: Anna Keller <anna.keller@starlightai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@starlightai.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 15:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Service update and executive summary — Starlight AI (short-term mitigation completed)

Marcus — thanks for the quick turnaround and the detailed note. The team verified conversion recovered after 10:45 PDT once your canary was ramped. We'd like to take you up on the 30-minute review tomorrow at 10:00 PDT to go over the postmortem draft and the planned runbook changes. Please invite whoever will own the kernel fix.

Also — we'll need the runbook diff and final postmortem available before the review so our infra lead can prep questions.

Appreciate the credit offer; procurement will follow up on the formal paperwork.

Best,
Anna
Head of Integrations, Starlight AI
